description: The plot illustrates the Attack Success Rate (ASR) for an AGNews clean-label scenario with a poison rate of 10% (2.5% of total) across various trigger words at different insertion positions. The categorical x-axis displays trigger words tilted diagonally, ordered from left to right as "cf", "bb", "WNBA", "ESPN", "NHL", "FIFA", "Estadio", and "athletics". The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Three solid lines represent different insertion positions. The "start" position is depicted by a green line with dot markers, which begins at approximately 0.77 for "cf", drops to a minimum of roughly 0.49 at "bb", sharply rises to about 0.90 at "WNBA", dips to 0.82 at "ESPN", and then trends upward to end at its peak of approximately 0.93 at "athletics". The "random" position is shown as an orange line with 'x' markers, starting at roughly 0.66 for "cf", decreasing to a low of about 0.52 at "bb", spiking to 0.88 at "WNBA", falling to 0.72 at "ESPN", climbing to a peak of approximately 0.93 at "Estadio", and ending at roughly 0.87 for "athletics". Finally, the "end" position is represented by a purple line with dot markers, beginning at approximately 0.75 for "cf", dropping to a minimum of about 0.57 at "bb", rising sharply to 0.90 at "WNBA", falling to 0.74 at "ESPN", fluctuating up to 0.89 at "NHL" and down to 0.81 at "FIFA", reaching its highest point of approximately 0.96 at "Estadio", and concluding at roughly 0.83 for "athletics".
